question: per pickup zone top 3 dropoff zones as JSON array with trips and avg total
sql:
WITH dest AS (
  SELECT PULocationID, DOLocationID,
         COUNT(*) AS trips,
         ROUND(AVG(total_amount), 2) AS avg_total
  FROM nyc_taxi_trips
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
nested AS (
  SELECT PULocationID,
         list(struct_pack(
           dropoff := DOLocationID,
           trips := trips,
           avg_total := avg_total
         ) ORDER BY trips DESC) AS dests
  FROM dest
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT PULocationID,
       to_json(list_slice(dests, 1, 3)) AS top_destinations_json,
       json_extract_string(to_json(list_slice(dests, 1, 3)), '$[0].dropoff') AS top_dropoff,
       json_extract_string(to_json(list_slice(dests, 1, 3)), '$[0].trips')::INT AS top_dropoff_trips
FROM nested
ORDER BY json_extract_string(to_json(list_slice(dests, 1, 3)), '$[0].trips')::INT DESC
LIMIT 10;

question: cost component totals across trips: fare, tip, tolls, surcharges as struct array unnest
sql:
WITH trip_components AS (
  SELECT [
    struct_pack(name := 'fare', amount := fare_amount),
    struct_pack(name := 'tip', amount := tip_amount),
    struct_pack(name := 'tolls', amount := tolls_amount),
    struct_pack(name := 'mta_tax', amount := mta_tax),
    struct_pack(name := 'improvement_surcharge', amount := improvement_surcharge),
    struct_pack(name := 'congestion_surcharge', amount := congestion_surcharge),
    struct_pack(name := 'airport_fee', amount := Airport_fee)
  ] AS components
  FROM nyc_taxi_trips
),
expanded AS (
  SELECT comp.name AS component_name,
         comp.amount
  FROM trip_components AS tc, LATERAL UNNEST(tc.components) AS t(comp)
)
SELECT component_name,
       COUNT(*) AS n,
       ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS total_amount,
       ROUND(AVG(amount), 4) AS avg_amount
FROM expanded
WHERE amount != 0
GROUP BY component_name
ORDER BY total_amount DESC;

question: per vendor peak hours with max hourly trips using list transform/filter/sum
sql:
WITH hourly AS (
  SELECT VendorID,
         EXTRACT(hour FROM tpep_pickup_datetime)::INT AS hr,
         COUNT(*) AS n,
         ROUND(AVG(passenger_count), 3) AS avg_pax
  FROM nyc_taxi_trips
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
nested AS (
  SELECT VendorID,
         MAX(n) AS max_n,
         list(struct_pack(hour := hr, n := n, avg_pax := avg_pax) ORDER BY hr) AS hours
  FROM hourly
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT VendorID,
       to_json(list_filter(hours, x -> x.n = max_n)) AS peak_hours_json,
       list_sum(list_transform(list_filter(hours, x -> x.n = max_n), x -> x.n)) AS peak_trips
FROM nested
ORDER BY peak_trips DESC;

question: vendor card payment share rows where share > 20%
sql:
WITH vendor_payments AS (
  SELECT VendorID, payment_type,
         COUNT(*) AS n,
         ROUND(AVG(total_amount), 2) AS avg_total
  FROM nyc_taxi_trips
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
totals AS (
  SELECT VendorID, SUM(n) AS vendor_trips
  FROM vendor_payments
  GROUP BY 1
),
nested AS (
  SELECT v.VendorID,
         t.vendor_trips,
         list(struct_pack(
           payment_type := v.payment_type,
           n := v.n,
           share := ROUND(100.0 * v.n / t.vendor_trips, 2),
           avg_total := v.avg_total
         ) ORDER BY v.n DESC) AS pay
  FROM vendor_payments v
  JOIN totals t ON v.VendorID = t.VendorID
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT VendorID, vendor_trips, p.payment_type, p.n, p.share, p.avg_total
FROM nested, LATERAL UNNEST(nested.pay) AS t(p)
WHERE p.payment_type IN (1, 2) AND p.share > 20
ORDER BY VendorID, p.share DESC;

question: hourly pickup demand zones JSON filter avg tip > 0.50
sql:
WITH hourly AS (
  SELECT PULocationID,
         EXTRACT(hour FROM tpep_pickup_datetime)::INT AS hr,
         COUNT(*) AS n,
         ROUND(AVG(tip_amount), 2) AS avg_tip
  FROM nyc_taxi_trips
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
nested AS (
  SELECT PULocationID,
         json_group_array(json_object(
           'hour', hr,
           'n', n,
           'avg_tip', avg_tip
         )) AS hours_json
  FROM hourly
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT ne.PULocationID,
       CAST(json_extract_string(e.v, '$.hour') AS INT) AS hour,
       CAST(json_extract_string(e.v, '$.n') AS INT) AS trips,
       CAST(json_extract_string(e.v, '$.avg_tip') AS DOUBLE) AS avg_tip
FROM nested ne, LATERAL json_each(ne.hours_json) AS e(k, v)
WHERE CAST(json_extract_string(e.v, '$.avg_tip') AS DOUBLE) > 0.50
ORDER BY trips DESC
LIMIT 20;

question: payment type distance band top 5 pickup zones nested JSON
sql:
WITH groups AS (
  SELECT payment_type,
         CASE
           WHEN trip_distance < 1 THEN 'short'
           WHEN trip_distance < 3 THEN 'medium'
           ELSE 'long'
         END AS distance_band,
         PULocationID,
         COUNT(*) AS trips
  FROM nyc_taxi_trips
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
),
band_pick AS (
  SELECT payment_type, distance_band, PULocationID, trips,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY payment_type, distance_band ORDER BY trips DESC) AS rn
  FROM groups
),
top_lists AS (
  SELECT payment_type, distance_band,
         list(struct_pack(pickup := PULocationID, trips := trips) ORDER BY trips DESC) AS top_pickups
  FROM band_pick
  WHERE rn <= 5
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
nested AS (
  SELECT payment_type,
         list(struct_pack(
           distance_band := distance_band,
           top_pickups := top_pickups
         ) ORDER BY distance_band) AS bands
  FROM top_lists
  GROUP BY 1
),
expanded AS (
  SELECT n.payment_type, b.distance_band AS distance_band, b.top_pickups AS top_pickups
  FROM nested n, LATERAL UNNEST(n.bands) AS e(b)
)
SELECT payment_type, distance_band,
       to_json(top_pickups) AS top_pickups_json,
       json_array_length(to_json(top_pickups)) AS n_pickups
FROM expanded
ORDER BY payment_type, distance_band;
